name: Sentora mWIN Main
oneLiner: senPYUSDmWIN is Sentora's PYUSD vault lending against mWIN on Morpho; interest accrues to shares, with withdrawals limited by liquidity.
collateral: PYUSD held idle in an immutable Morpho Vault V2 and supplied by a MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 to a mWIN-collateralized lending market. Allocations can change under curator controls.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares convert to PYUSD at the live assets-per-share rate. Interest increases and recognized losses reduce share value; withdrawals use idle assets and configured adapter liquidity rather than a fixed dollar promise.
